channel.title: The Nostr Observer
channel.description: A daily front page printed from twenty-four hours of Nostr, ranked through one reader's own web of trust.

item.title: Monday, September 21, 2026 — Routstr adds Jev. The operator still matters.
item.description: The classifier can now be paid for in sats. In the discussion around its arrival, redshift spells out what users still have to trust about a provider.

item.title: Sunday, September 20, 2026 — A guitar kept since 1979 changes hands
item.description: After Joe Martin’s show in Flore, the organiser went home and came back with a Fylde. The gift came with a wish: take it on tour.

item.title: Friday, September 18, 2026 — After the theft, one builder stays on Liquid
item.description: OceanSlim argues that the contract designs can outlast the chain they run on. Elsewhere in the same reading, users are still asking how to get their money out.

item.title: Thursday, September 17, 2026 — The exit button is a file
item.description: Ditto can gather a Nostr history onto a device and send it back to a different relay. The useful part is the restore. The limits matter too.

item.title: Wednesday, September 16, 2026 — Attackers claim 147 GB of Revolut data
item.description: A forged Italian government order reportedly opened the bank’s customer files, and the compliance rules gave it no good way to tell.

item.title: Tuesday, September 15, 2026 — 126 changes later, the CLARITY Act gets its vote
item.description: Senate Republicans released what they called the final draft on Monday. The procedural vote is today at 2pm Eastern.

item.title: Monday, September 14, 2026 — Revolut handed it all over, and the rules say it was right to
item.description: Passports, selfies, addresses, IBANs, full transaction histories. The request was forged. Nobody was required to check.

item.title: Tuesday, September 8, 2026 — They kept fifteen per cent, and the word “white hat” did not survive it
item.description: The coins came back. What happened in between was a public argument in which one of the most careful people on this network talked himself out of his own position.

item.title: Monday, September 7, 2026 — Ninety-five per cent of the reserves walked out, and the fix had been written a month earlier
item.description: A seven-year-old shortcut in a verification cache let someone conjure L-BTC out of nothing. The patch existed on 3 August. It was never released.

item.title: Sunday, September 6, 2026 — Two years of running the room, and nobody clapped
item.description: Car spent Saturday explaining why they stopped trying to build a Nostr developer community — and what Matthew 10:14 has to do with it.

item.title: Saturday, September 5, 2026 — A drone one minute down the street, and a day's work carried on
item.description: Terry Yiu dropped his wife at her office in central Kyiv on Friday morning. An hour later the building a minute away was hit. By the evening he was posting about a rewrite of his app.
